UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd minecraft-gtnh || exit 1; S=gtnh-staging; if [ ! -f $S/lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar ]; then echo 'GTNH server pack not found after download. Check the Server Pack URL setting'; exit 1; fi; if [ '{{CleanInstall}}' = 'true' ]; then echo 'Removing old mods, libraries and config folders (keeping config/JourneyMapServer)'; if [ -d config/JourneyMapServer ]; then rm -rf jms-keep; mv config/JourneyMapServer jms-keep; fi; rm -rf mods libraries config; fi; for f in server.properties eula.txt ops.json whitelist.json banned-ips.json banned-players.json usercache.json; do if [ -e $f ]; then rm -f $S/$f; fi; done; for d in serverutilities journeymap; do if [ -d $d ]; then rm -rf $S/$d; fi; done; cp -a $S/. ./ || exit 1; if [ -d jms-keep ]; then mkdir -p config; rm -rf config/JourneyMapServer; mv jms-keep config/JourneyMapServer; fi; rm -rf $S; echo 'GTNH server files installed'"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location -Path 'minecraft-gtnh'; $S='gtnh-staging'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $S 'lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar'))) { Write-Output 'GTNH server pack not found after download. Check the Server Pack URL setting'; exit 1 }; if ('{{CleanInstall}}' -eq 'true') { Write-Output 'Removing old mods, libraries and config folders (keeping config/JourneyMapServer)'; if (Test-Path 'config/JourneyMapServer') { Remove-Item 'jms-keep' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item 'config/JourneyMapServer' 'jms-keep' }; Remove-Item -Path 'mods','libraries','config' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; foreach ($f in 'server.properties','eula.txt','ops.json','whitelist.json','banned-ips.json','banned-players.json','usercache.json') { if (Test-Path $f) { Remove-Item (Join-Path $S $f) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; foreach ($d in 'serverutilities','journeymap') { if (Test-Path $d) { Remove-Item (Join-Path $S $d) -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; robocopy $S . /E /IS /IT /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { Write-Output 'Copying the pack files failed'; exit 1 }; Remove-Item $S -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path 'jms-keep') { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'config' | Out-Null; Remove-Item 'config/JourneyMapServer' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item 'jms-keep' 'config/JourneyMapServer' }; Write-Output 'GTNH server files installed'; exit 0"

-c "cd minecraft-gtnh && if [[ -x java/bin/java ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(java/bin/java --version | grep \"Temurin-\" | head -n1 | sed -n \"s/.*Temurin-\\([^[:space:]]\\+\\).*/\\1/p\"); else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; LatestVersionBuild=$(wget -qO- \"https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/{{JavaVersion}}/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&os=linux&vendor=eclipse\" | jq -r \".[0].version.openjdk_version\" | sed \"s/-LTS$//\"); if [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$LatestVersionBuild\" ]]; then echo \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f java.tar.gz ]] && rm -f java.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO java.tar.gz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{JavaVersion}}/ga/linux/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse || { echo \"Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p java && rm -rf java/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar -xzf java.tar.gz -C java --strip-components=1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f java.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && chmod +x java/bin/java && echo \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild downloaded\"; fi"

-c "cd minecraft-gtnh && if [[ -x java/bin/java ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(java/bin/java --version | grep \"Temurin-\" | head -n1 | sed -n \"s/.*Temurin-\\([^[:space:]]\\+\\).*/\\1/p\"); else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; LatestVersionBuild=$(wget -qO- \"https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/{{JavaVersion}}/hotspot?architecture=aarch64&image_type=jdk&os=linux&vendor=eclipse\" | jq -r \".[0].version.openjdk_version\" | sed \"s/-LTS$//\"); if [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$LatestVersionBuild\" ]]; then echo \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f java.tar.gz ]] && rm -f java.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO java.tar.gz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{JavaVersion}}/ga/linux/aarch64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse || { echo \"Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p java && rm -rf java/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar -xzf java.tar.gz -C java --strip-components=1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f java.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && chmod +x java/bin/java && echo \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild downloaded\"; fi"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'minecraft-gtnh'; if (Test-Path 'java/bin/java.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& java/bin/java.exe --version | Select-String -Pattern 'Temurin-(\d+(?:\.\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?\+\d+)' | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value }) } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; $LatestVersionBuild = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/{{JavaVersion}}/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&os=windows&vendor=eclipse\")[0].version.openjdk_version -replace '-LTS$', ''; if ( $InstalledVersion -eq $LatestVersionBuild ) { Write-Output \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path java.zip ) { Remove-Item java.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{JavaVersion}}/ga/windows/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse -OutFile java.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"java.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path java.zip ) { Remove-Item java.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"jdk-*\") { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like \"jdk-*\" } | Rename-Item -NewName \"java\" *> $null; Write-Output \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild downloaded\" } }"
